definitions.gloss: to be moved to tears; to get teary-eyed; to well up with tears
definitions.explanation: To have tears form in one's eyes without necessarily crying. Describes the moment when emotion causes tears to well up, whether from sadness, joy, or being deeply moved.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感動|かんどう}して→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧{涙|なみだ}ぐんだ。
examples.english: I was moved and got teary-eyed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{涙|なみだ}ぐんで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher was getting teary-eyed at the graduation ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{涙|なみだ}ぐんでしまった。
examples.english: Seeing a friend I hadn't met in a long time, I couldn't help but well up with tears.

notes:
Describes the state just before actual crying — tears forming in the eyes. More restrained than ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ (to cry).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{感動|かんどう}して→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧{涙|なみだ}ぐむ (to be moved to tears)
- ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{涙|なみだ}ぐむ (to involuntarily get teary-eyed)
- {涙|なみだ}ぐむ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (a voice choked with tears)

USAGE:
{涙|なみだ}ぐむ is intransitive and focuses on the involuntary emotional response of tears welling up. It is more literary and expressive than simply saying ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (tears come out).
